text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(A training routine that's easy to run...
I'm in great shape too... With this—)
choice_data_list: How about we do one more run?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I was just about to say the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —On that day, I had a dream.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: A dream of becoming a comet trailing blue light.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Through the dark galaxy,
paying no heed to the stardust grazing past.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I dreamed of running until I burned out.
